import re
import sys

values = {}
order = list("abcdefghijklmnop") + ["TMP"]

for line in sys.stdin:
    line = line.split("//", 1)[0].strip()
    if not line:
        continue

    match = re.fullmatch(r"(\w+)\s*<-\s*(.*?)\s*;", line)
    if not match:
        continue

    name, expr = match.groups()
    literal = re.fullmatch(r"\d+", expr)
    update = re.fullmatch(r"\(\s*(\w+)\s*\+\s*(\d+)\s*\)\s*mod\s*100", expr)

    if literal:
        values[name] = int(expr)
    elif update:
        variable, amount = update.groups()
        values[name] = (values[variable] + int(amount)) % 100

print("; ".join(f"{name} ?= {values[name]}" for name in order) + ";")
